I'm locating the NZ atom of K54, excluding its own CE and CD neighbors, then scanning for nearby atoms with y-coordinates around 12-16 and z around 7-12 to find residues close in space.

CG on the same lysine is actually 3 bonds from NZ, so it counts as allowed. I check the distance to CB too, then widen my search across nearby residues like SER48, ASP51, and SER53, but none seem close enough in x/y/z. It looks like NZ might be solvent-exposed, so I'm continuing to scan other residues like GLY49 that fall within the broader coordinate range.

ASP51 CB gives a distance of about 5.6, so still farther than LYS54 CG's 3.88. Since CG is only a 1-4 covalent connection from the reference atom, it should count as a valid candidate rather than being excluded, so I'm checking whether any other atom beats that 3.88 figure, like LYS54 CA, which turns out too far.

Scanning more coordinates in the y>11 range—ASP51, SER53, and LYS54 side chain atoms—none come close to beating 3.88, confirming LYS54 CG as the closest qualifying atom.
